raw_text: INTEL: State-sponsored APT group attempting to breach DRDO internal research network. Attack vector is a supply chain compromise through a third-party IT vendor. Custom malware disguised as a legitimate software update for laboratory management systems. Initial indicators point to a South Asian threat actor with nation-state backing. NIA investigation expected.
clean_text: State-sponsored APT targeting DRDO research network via supply chain attack through third-party IT vendor. Custom malware disguised as lab management software update.
